items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I thought, 'Oh, God, Kennedy's really blown it while we're gone. This is it.'

ctx.x: That American image is quite cheesy(?) in Moscow, isn't it?

Well, that was in the missile crisis. We were in Tashkent when they had an air raid drill right in the middle of the Cuban missile crisis. And Dave and I were up in our hotel room looking out on the balcony and these soldiers come running up in our room with these Kelishnokov automatic rifles, or something, and scared the Jesus out of me. They drag us into the room, pull the blinds, yell at us in Russian, go through all our drawers and then run back down the street. So we turned out the lights and peeked out and…
That's quite of a big country, isn't it.
